intelligence_brief.title: Semiconductor Supply Chain and Critical Mineral Geopolitical Assessment

Taiwan.developments: TSMC continues to accelerate 2nm node production timelines amidst heightened cross-strait military posturing. Supply chain resilience remains the primary focus for global foundry partners.
Taiwan.critical_minerals: Stable supply of neon and photoresists despite regional logistical bottlenecks.

Japan.developments: Government subsidies for Rapidus Corporation are being bolstered to secure domestic logic chip manufacturing capabilities by 2027.
Japan.critical_minerals: Increased investment in rare earth element recycling technologies to reduce dependency on external suppliers.

United_States.developments: Department of Commerce CHIPS Act funding tranches are being finalized for major domestic fabrication projects to mitigate reliance on Asian manufacturing hubs.
United_States.critical_minerals: Expansion of domestic lithium and gallium extraction projects in the Western region to secure upstream supply chains.

European_Union.developments: The EU Chips Act is driving cross-border collaboration to establish a 2nm ecosystem, focusing on automotive and industrial grade semiconductors.
European_Union.critical_minerals: Strategic partnerships with African nations for cobalt and copper sourcing are being renegotiated to align with ESG and supply security mandates.
